WITH f AS (SELECT `Franchise Country`, MEASURE(`Franchise Count`) AS franchise_count FROM ${target_catalog}.${target_schema}.mv_bakehouse_supplier_coverage GROUP BY ALL),
s AS (SELECT `Franchise Country`, MEASURE(`Franchises with Sales`) AS franchises_with_sales FROM ${target_catalog}.${target_schema}.mv_bakehouse_sales GROUP BY ALL)
SELECT f.`Franchise Country`, f.franchise_count, COALESCE(s.franchises_with_sales, 0) AS franchises_with_sales
FROM f LEFT JOIN s ON s.`Franchise Country` = f.`Franchise Country`
ORDER BY f.franchise_count DESC, f.`Franchise Country`

question: For each store country, how many franchise stores are there and how many of them recorded a sale?

content:
WITH f AS (SELECT `Franchise Size`, MEASURE(`Franchises with Supplier`) AS with_supplier FROM ${target_catalog}.${target_schema}.mv_bakehouse_supplier_coverage GROUP BY ALL),
fi AS (SELECT `Franchise ID`, `Franchise Size` FROM ${target_catalog}.${target_schema}.mv_bakehouse_supplier_coverage WHERE `Supplier Status` = 'Supplier on file' GROUP BY ALL),
s AS (SELECT `Franchise ID`, MEASURE(`Franchises with Sales`) AS with_sales FROM ${target_catalog}.${target_schema}.mv_bakehouse_sales GROUP BY ALL),
j AS (SELECT fi.`Franchise Size`, SUM(s.with_sales) AS with_sales FROM fi JOIN s ON s.`Franchise ID` = fi.`Franchise ID` GROUP BY fi.`Franchise Size`)
SELECT f.`Franchise Size`, f.with_supplier, COALESCE(j.with_sales, 0) AS with_sales, ROUND(COALESCE(j.with_sales, 0) / f.with_supplier, 4) AS share_selling
FROM f LEFT JOIN j ON j.`Franchise Size` = f.`Franchise Size`
WHERE f.with_supplier > 0
ORDER BY f.`Franchise Size`

WITH s AS (SELECT `Franchise ID`, MEASURE(`Units Sold`) AS units_sold, MEASURE(`Transaction Count`) AS transactions FROM ${target_catalog}.${target_schema}.mv_bakehouse_sales GROUP BY ALL),
f AS (SELECT `Franchise ID`, `Supplier Name` FROM ${target_catalog}.${target_schema}.mv_bakehouse_supplier_coverage WHERE `Supplier Status` = 'Supplier on file' GROUP BY ALL)
SELECT f.`Supplier Name`, ROUND(SUM(s.units_sold) / SUM(s.transactions), 2) AS units_per_transaction
FROM s JOIN f ON f.`Franchise ID` = s.`Franchise ID`

content: For revenue per customer, purchase frequency, repeat customer rate or customer coverage, use mv_bakehouse_customer_activity; do not derive them from mv_bakehouse_sales.
When a user asks for supplier coverage or approved supplier share without saying the basis, show both the franchise-basis and the supplier-basis measures and name each basis.
For 'top N' / 'which N' questions, return exactly N rows: ORDER BY the measure DESC and LIMIT N (not RANK() <= N, which returns extra rows on ties).
